spec2viz — semantic specs -> diagrams -> catalog HTML

Where the diagrams live:
  package examples : /home/jp/proyectos/SLDB_1/spec2viz/examples
    - activity    activity/example.yml, activity/validation.yml
    - catalog     catalog/leaves/architecture-vistas.yml, catalog/leaves/sample-component.yml, catalog/project.yml
    - class       class/runtime.yml
    - component   component/example.yml
    - deployment  deployment/example.yml
    - fixtures    fixtures/canonical.yml
    - matrix      matrix/example.yml
    - reflection  reflection/canonical.yml
    - sequence    sequence/example.yml
    - state       state/example.yml
  catalog config   : examples/catalog/project.yml

Flow to HTML:
  1. diagram validate <spec.yml>
  2. diagram render   <spec.yml> --out <dir>
  3. diagram lint     <rendered.mmd>
  4. catalog build    --config <vistas.yml> --out <out.html>
     (build alias = catalog build; --atoms-dir injects window.ATOMS_DB)

Serve a built catalog:
  catalog serve --html <out.html> --port 8000
